recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮被成片中型、核質比高的腫瘤細胞取代，細胞核卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻並有明顯核仁，可見核分裂與凋亡小體，腫瘤細胞在殘存膠原束之間浸潤；這種單調的母細胞樣浸潤需以免疫染色排除淋巴瘤，才可確立骨髓肉瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells infiltrating between residual dermal collagen bundles
High N:C ratio with oval to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei
Fine to vesicular chromatin with small distinct nucleoli
Frequent mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Scant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm; no obvious eosinophilic myelocytes identified
describe_en: Skin biopsy at higher power shows the dermis replaced by diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells infiltrating between residual collagen bundles. The cells have a high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, oval to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin, and distinct small nucleoli, with scant pale cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified. The morphology is that of a high-grade blastic neoplasm, and immunohistochemistry is required for lineage; with myeloid marker expression (MPO, CD33, lysozyme), the findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are often larger with vesicular chromatin and are CD20/PAX5 positive and MPO negative.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has a similar starry-sky blastic look with finer chromatin and less conspicuous nucleoli, but is TdT positive with B- or T-lineage markers and MPO negative.
BPDCN typically spares the epidermis with a grenz zone and involves dermis similarly, but is CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4 positive and MPO negative.
Merkel cell carcinoma shows salt-and-pepper chromatin with nuclear molding and CK20 perinuclear dot staining.
